candidates.statement: Slack is the primary mode of communication within the university; the stakeholder mainly uses it to communicate with peers and professors.

evidence_candidates.quote: slack is the primary mode of communication within my university, so I mainly use Slack to communicate with my peers and my professors

candidates.statement: The stakeholder uses Slack every day to talk to peers, teaching assistants in various subjects and professors, with usage increasing over the semester.

evidence_candidates.quote: it's definitely something that I use every day to talk to my peers, my teaching, teaching assistants in various subjects, and also my professors

candidates.statement: Communicate instantly with anyone the stakeholder wishes to talk to within the university.
candidates.modality: stated preference and self-named goal ('the first goal that I mentioned')

evidence_candidates.quote: it's instant communication with anyone I wish to talk to within the university
circling back to the first goal that I mentioned is that of instant communication

candidates.statement: Reach a person by looking them up by name, without having to save their phone number or email address first.

evidence_candidates.quote: if I know their name, or sometimes even their last name, I can look them up, and I can reach out to them almost immediately.
I don't need to like, save their numbers, save their email

candidates.statement: Reach people from either the phone or the laptop.

evidence_candidates.quote: I can do it over my phone. I can do it if my laptop's open

candidates.statement: Reach a wide audience immediately through the channel feature, where the same reach over email would take more time.

evidence_candidates.quote: I also like the channel feature within slack, where I can reach a wide audience immediately
if I was doing that over email or something, it would take me more time

candidates.statement: Have the channel's history available at the moment of joining, including information posted before joining.
candidates.modality: stated liking ('another thing that I like') and judged advantage

evidence_candidates.quote: when I join a channel, I have the history of that channel at my fingertips, like so I have access to information that was there before I even joined the channel

candidates.statement: Know what people are talking about and what everyone is sharing, whether on a particular subject or in general.

evidence_candidates.quote: it's good to know what people are talking about, what everyone's sharing, be it with respect to a particular subject, or could just be in general

candidates.statement: Hear what is happening in the department, in the program and around campus.

evidence_candidates.quote: I like to hear what's happening around within the department, within the program, what's happening around campus

candidates.statement: Share documents when collaborating with teammates, as the most used feature within direct messaging.

evidence_candidates.quote: my most used feature is sharing documents when collaborating with teammates

candidates.statement: Share a document instantly with a teammate as a way of achieving instant communication.
candidates.modality: explanation of how the feature serves the named goal

evidence_candidates.quote: slack provides a pretty neat way to share a document instantly with a teammate

candidates.statement: Attach any type of file from local folders through the attach option and send it to the person.

evidence_candidates.quote: there is an option to attach a document, and I can attach any type of file I want

candidates.statement: Format text (bold, italics) and send emojis in the message box.

evidence_candidates.quote: I can send you emojis. I can format the text, whatever, any way I want.

candidates.statement: Enter keywords in the search feature to look for something specific, for example something the professor said.

evidence_candidates.quote: there is a search feature that I would use to I would enter keywords to look, to look for something specific
I would search for something that the professor said, using the keyword over there

candidates.statement: Searching returns too much information from channel history before joining, so the wanted message is hard to find unless the stakeholder knows exactly what to look for.
candidates.modality: reported difficulty ('a problem that I encountered')

evidence_candidates.quote: coming back to the slack, showing me everything from a channel that you know before I even joined
sometimes when I search for a keyword or keywords, I get way too much information in the search results
it's a little difficult to pass through things unless I know exactly what I'm looking for

candidates.statement: Video and audio calls are harder to start than in Microsoft Teams because it takes more time and several windows to navigate; it would be easier if the feature were more accessible.
candidates.modality: reported limitation plus wish ('it would be easier')

evidence_candidates.quote: I find that it's a little harder to have video calls or audio calls
it would be easier if it was just more access

candidates.statement: When the person is known and their email or phone number is at hand, call them directly outside Slack instead of using Slack calls.
candidates.modality: described workaround ('I would just call them')

evidence_candidates.quote: if I have their email with not their emails, or if their phone number with me, I would just call them

candidates.statement: Continue using Slack for communication within the university rather than switching to another application.
candidates.modality: stated intention ('I would still use Slack')

evidence_candidates.quote: I would still use Slack because ultimately, it's the fastest way to communicate with people within the university
I don't think it's, it's convincing enough for me to switch to a different application

candidates.statement: Not abandon Slack for lacking all functions in one application, given that it does provide options to collaborate and make a call.

evidence_candidates.quote: Since it does provide the, you know, the option to collaborate and in, you know, make a call, I wouldn't, you know, abandon the app.

candidates.statement: Have a quick email feature that immediately navigates to Outlook, Gmail or another standard email app so the stakeholder can email the person, for situations where an email is expected.

evidence_candidates.quote: I would like a quick email feature
there are certain situations where you know an email is expected, like when you have formal communication within with your teaching assistants or your professors
a feature that would just immediately navigate to an Outlook or Gmail or any, any standard email app where I can email the person I want to

candidates.statement: Have the call feature more accessible, especially in a group setting.

evidence_candidates.quote: I would like the call feature more accessible as well, yeah, especially in a group setting

candidates.statement: Advise new users that everyone in the Slack community is accessible by knowing only their name or surname, and highlight collaboration features such as document sharing.
candidates.modality: advice to prospective new users ('I would make them aware')

evidence_candidates.quote: I would make them aware of the fact that you know everyone within this lac community is super accessible
definitely highlight the features or collaboration like document sharing and other document sharing and similar features

candidates.statement: Improve navigation of Slack when the browser window is shrunk to sit side by side with other open windows.
candidates.modality: weak suggestion ('an area of improvement that could be considered')

evidence_candidates.quote: shrink the size of slack browser window, I feel like it's a little hard to navigate through the application
I feel like that is an area of improvement that could be considered

candidates.statement: The layout works well on a phone and on a big screen such as a 14 inch laptop.
candidates.modality: positive status report bounding the improvement

evidence_candidates.quote: it works well on a phone and if on a big screen, like a 14 inch laptop
